notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Choose which alerts you want to receive. You can turn everything off at once, or fine-tune each category.
notifications.masterToggleDesc: Turning this off stops every notification below, without changing your individual choices.

items.postFailureDesc: Get notified when a scheduled post fails to publish.
items.publishSuccessDesc: Get notified whenever a post is published successfully.
items.channelDisconnectDesc: Get notified when a channel is disconnected or a sync fails.
items.collaborationDesc: Get updates about team invites, role changes, and approval requests.
items.emptyQueueDesc: Get notified when a brand has no posts scheduled.
items.billingDesc: Get payment reminders and other billing-related notices.
items.dailyRecapDesc: A daily summary of what was published today.
items.weeklyReportDesc: A weekly summary of what was published this week.

profile.title: Personal profile
profile.subtitle: Manage your public profile settings and customize how summary metrics are received.
profile.metricsReportDesc: We will send you a monthly analytics report containing reach, content overview, and comparison indices automatically.
profile.alternativeEmailDesc: When this field is empty the monthly summary is sent to {{email}}
profile.themeDesc: Choose between light and dark interface.

security.title: Access information
security.subtitle: This is your access information. You'll need to introduce your password to perform any change.
security.createNewPasswordPlaceholder: Create a password for direct login
security.passwordHint: Enter a new password with at least 6 characters to change your current password.
security.googleHint: Your account is logged in via Google. Set a password here if you want to also sign in using Email & Password.
security.twoFactorDesc: To increase the security of your account you can enable 2-factor authentication (2FA) with your mobile device.
security.linkedAccountsDesc: Link with a Google account to log in quickly with 1-click.

support.title: Technical Support (Chat)
support.subtitle: Review support history or chat directly with us.
support.archiveHint: This is archived history. This conversation is closed.
support.liveChatSubtitle: Ask questions to get immediate assistance
support.sessionClosed: This support session has been closed.
support.agentConnected: System: Staff {{name}} connected to the conversation.
support.agentAssigned: Staff {{name}} has taken your chat session.
support.welcomeMessage: Hello! 👋 How can I help you today? Send a message to start a new support session.
support.resolvedMessage: Chat session ended. You can view support history in Settings.
support.systemWaitMessage: System: Please wait a moment, support staff is connecting...
